items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed. Risk severity is high for go-live, new public exposure, and security-sensitive releases. Fleet-doctor is not OK and has no run, findings, or checks; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness remain unevidenced. Keep existing gates unchanged. Permit ordinary reversible growth only within the documented containment boundaries.
